content.short: Fanton is a Telegram fantasy football game where players build squads and compete for TON and NFT rewards.
content.description: Fanton runs fantasy football through a Telegram web app built around digital player cards and tournament competition. Official product materials describe building squads with free or NFT cards, joining contests tied to major football leagues, tracking live player performance, and earning rewards such as TON or new cards. The game is aimed at football fans who want a faster and more mobile format than traditional fantasy products while staying inside Telegram for regular team management, contest entry, and daily play.
content.meta: Fanton is a Telegram fantasy football game with card based squads, tournament play, and TON rewards for active players and fans.
